name: @ausm/device-macos-camera
description: macOS webcam capture (AVFoundation) into POSIX shared memory, with a Node client and on-demand JPEG frames

scripts.build:helper: cd swift && swift build -c release --arch arm64 --arch x86_64 -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker "$(pwd)/Sources/CameraHelper/Info.plist" && mkdir -p ../build && cp "$(swift build -c release --arch arm64 --arch x86_64 --show-bin-path)/CameraHelper" ../build/camera-helper && codesign --force --sign "${SIGN_IDENTITY:--}" --identifier "com.ausm.camera-helper" ../build/camera-helper
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist && cd swift && swift package clean
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build

author: Timeless
